name: feature_dependency_analysis
description: Analyzes feature-to-feature dependencies — which features a new one depends on, which it conflicts with, and which existing contracts or data models it shares. The planner's risk_analysis feeds this to catch integration risks before implementation.

inputs.name: existing_features
inputs.description: List of previously persisted feature_spec ids to check against.

outputs.name: dependency_graph
outputs.description: { depends_on: [{feature_id, interface_overlap}], conflicts_with: [{feature_id, reason}], shared_models: [{model_name, used_by}] }

error_codes.message: Adding this feature would create a dependency cycle.
error_codes.recovery: Report the cycle path; suggest redefinition to break it.

examples: feature_spec for oauth with existing features=[auth] -> dependency_graph with depends_on=[auth] and shared_models=[User].
